explanation: Build a Huffman tree by repeatedly merging the two least frequent candidate subtrees. Traverse the resulting tree to assign bit strings, then sum each frequency times its code length and divide by 100 as the corpus requires.
timeComplexity: O(n log(n+1) + Σ code lengths) expected time; O(n^2) is a worst-case bound.
spaceComplexity: O(n + Σ code lengths) space for the tree, heap and assigned code strings.
